svg.text: 1:4 · holes Ø7.6 · pitch 23.876 (0.94 in) · columns from the left hole column, rows from the top hole row · blue = arms, flanges, shelf
Row = the lowest of the arm's three studs.
Studs go in the three holes of one column;
the arm leaves the flange bottom, so its top
sits 13 mm above that stud's centre.
